name: riemann-map
description: Research-grade Riemann-map / conformal-mapping studio. A new suite app (separate app per CLAUDE.md decision 8) built on the shared @cas/* packages: custom φ via @cas/expr (JS+GLSL), numerical φ⁻¹ via @cas/schwarz, the WebGL2/df64/colormap substrate via @cas/gpu, and hand-off + permalinks via @cas/interchange. P0 = the empty, tested, deployable scaffold.
